text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r f-a-i-l-e-d to d-r-a-w u-p a n-y f-a-l-s-e b-r-e-e-d-i-n-g r-e-c-o-r-d-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g n-o o-n-d-i-s-k a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n of l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e b-r-e-e-d-i-n-g p-r-o-v-e-n-a-n-c-e.
2) the a-c-t-o-r d-i-d n-o-t m-a-n-i-f-e-s-t a n-y o-w-n-e-r-s-h-i-p h-i-s-t-o-r-y d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s, c-r-e-a-t-i-n-g z-e-r-o t-a-i-l a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l r-e-v-i-e-w.
3) the a-c-t-o-r r-e-f-r-a-i-n-e-d f-r-o-m f-o-r-g-i-n-g o-f-f-i-c-i-a-l p-e-r-m-i-t-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g n-o c-o-p-i-e-s b-e-h-i-n-d, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the l-i-c-e-n-s-i-n-g c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e c-h-e-c-k.
4) the a-c-t-o-r a-b-s-t-a-i-n-e-d f-r-o-m p-o-s-t-i-n-g f-r-a-u-d-u-l-e-n-t o-n-l-i-n-e l-i-s-t-i-n-g-s, r-e-s-u-l-t-i-n-g i-n n-o d-i-g-i-t-a-l f-o-o-t-p-r-i-n-t-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the e-n-l-i-s-t-m-e-n-t v-e-t-t-i-n-g p-r-o-c-e-s-s.
5) the a-c-t-o-r n-e-v-e-r d-e-c-e-i-v-e-d w-i-l-d-l-i-f-e o-f-f-i-c-e-r-s, g-e-n-e-r-a-t-i-n-g n-o e-n-f-o-r-c-e-m-e-n-t i-n-c-i-d-e-n-t-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n e-v-a-l-u-a-t-i-o-n.
